scripts.dev: concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend && node -e "fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});"
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
